subject: mathematics
concept: Introducing decimals as another way to write simple fractions (e.g. 1/2 = 0.5)
source_inspiration: adapted from Singapore CPA sequencing principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student compares a shaded fraction tile to an equivalent shaded decimal grid
exercise.pictorial: Student matches fraction bar models to their decimal grid equivalents
exercise.abstract: Student writes the decimal equivalent for a simple, familiar fraction

misconception_flags: treats decimal digits as a whole number (e.g. reads 0.5 as five)

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
